name: Entre-Deux: Maudit
source:
Entre-Deux
At Medocorilia, a world invaded by zombies, a pregnant woman tries to survive, until she meets the elusive Entre-Deux. Now, Elrica must gain their Trust to stay alive.

Dark Fairies and Cursed Queen
At Medocorilia, in an Alternate Reality where the zombie apocalypse never happened…
After his girlfriend broke up with him, Denis accidently freed the Cursed Queen and her evil Dark Fairies. He must stop them somehow.

Witch and Seimoya
At Medocorilia, in an Alternate Reality where the zombie apocalypse never happened…
When Jesabel and her friend Manolita summoned a wicked with, they got to stop her. Maybe a Seimoya (spirit) could help?

Three stories…
All connected…
Entre-Deux: Cursed!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/940130/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
双人间
在梅多科里利亚，一个被僵尸入侵的世界，一名孕妇试图生存，直到她遇到了难以捉摸的二人组。现在，艾尔丽卡必须赢得他们的信任才能活下去。

黑暗妖精和被诅咒的女王
在梅多科里利亚，在另一个现实中，僵尸末日从未发生过……
在女友与他分手后，丹尼斯意外地释放了被诅咒的女王和她邪恶的黑暗精灵。他必须想办法阻止他们。

魔女与星魔也
在梅多科里利亚，在另一个现实中，僵尸末日从未发生过……
当杰莎贝尔和她的朋友马诺丽塔召唤恶人时，他们必须阻止她。也许Seimoya（灵魂）可以帮忙？

三个故事……
所有连接…
双人间：该死！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/940130/]Steam[/url]]
